data.one_liner: Google ML Kit text recognition (OCR) plugin for Flutter supporting Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides real-time camera text recognition and image byte OCR using Google ML Kit. Supports multiple languages including Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Devanagari, and returns text blocks, lines, and elements with their bounding coordinates.
use_when: You need real-time OCR text recognition from a camera preview
You need to scan text from image bytes on Android and iOS
You want built-in support for multiple languages like Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
avoid_when: You only need barcode or QR code scanning without full text recognition
You are targeting iOS simulators with arm64 where static libraries are not supported
strengths: Real-time camera preview text recognition with overlay customization
Supports both camera streams and static image byte recognition
Multiple language support including Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
weaknesses: iOS static libraries do not support arm64 simulators (requires real device or Rosetta)
Requires specific platform versions like iOS 15.5+ and Android minSdk 23
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera and photo library usage descriptions to Info.plist on iOS and meeting platform requirements such as iOS 15.5+ and Android minSdk 23.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need fast and versatile barcode or QR code scanning instead of general text OCR.
